scope: Direct AMD GPU model runs. Transfer fixtures were used to fix unit formatting, so their final result is development evidence, not a blind held-out score. No official hidden evaluation or full Docker GPU launch has been performed.
memory_measurement_scope: Kernel monitor sees all GPUs on the shared host. The 27.46 GiB maximum includes a neighbouring GPU already occupied at the first sample; do not attribute that number exclusively to our worker. Report PyTorch peak reserved separately. Assigned PCI-to-torch-device identity was not recorded.
